newsitem.title: USA: Endosonics amends Cardiometrics deal. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Endosonics amends Cardiometrics deal. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]

text.p: Endosonics Corp said Wednesday it had revised its merger agreement with Cardiometrics Inc, increasing the cash portion of the agreement.
Under the amended deal, Cardiometrics shareholders will receive for each share held $3.00 in cash versus the original plan of $2 in cash.

The exchange ratio for CardioVascular Dynamics Inc shares was reduced from a range of 0.20 to 0.2636 to a range of 0.1364 to 0.19. The exchange ratio for EndoSonics shares was unchanged by the amendment.
(Corrects above paragraph to clarify the range was reduced but the ratio remained unchanged).
In addition, the amendment removed the provision enabling Cardiometrics to terminate the agreement if the total merger consideration is below $8.00.
EndoSonics develops, manufactures and markets intravascular ultrasound imaging systems and catheters.
EndoSonics owns a little over 4 million shares, or about 45 percent, of Cardiovascular Dynamics, which develops and markets stent delivery systems and vascular access products.
Cardiometrics develops, manufactures and markets intravascular medical devices to measure blood flow impairment caused by coronary artery disease.
